news.headline: Datadog Just Dropped 34% in a Week. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog stock fell 34% in a week, first in a software selloff that also hit ServiceNow and Cloudflare, then on a flat fourth-quarter outlook. That outlook assumes Datadog’s largest customer, an AI company, pays only its minimum; growth from everyone else is guided to the low to mid-30s.

news.headline: 56% Upside for Datadog? Canaccord Genuity Thinks So, and Here’s How
news.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog beat Wall Street’s third-quarter estimates, but a flat fourth-quarter revenue outlook left the stock 36% below its October high. Canaccord Genuity kept its Buy rating and $295 target on Nov.

news.headline: Datadog Q3 Earnings & Revenues Surpass Estimates, Both Rise Y/Y
news.summary: DDOG's Q3 EPS rises 47.3% and revenues climb 35.2%, beating estimates as AI adoption widens. Q4 guidance assumes its largest customer's minimum commitment.

news.headline: DDOG Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Growth and Customer Renewals
news.summary: Datadog's Q3 revenues surge 35%, with adjusted EPS beating estimates, but AI customer discounts and cautious Q4 guidance temper its growth outlook.

news.headline: Needham’s $300 Target Says Datadog’s Selloff Went Too Far
news.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog stock is down 36% from its October high, most recently after a fourth-quarter outlook that showed flat revenue from the third quarter. Needham repeated its Buy rating and $300 target on Wednesday, 59% above the close and near the $296 consensus target.

news.headline: Wedbush Maintains Outperform on Datadog, Lowers Price Target to $240
news.summary: Wedbush  analyst Steven Wahrhaftig   maintains Datadog (NASDAQ:DDOG) with a Outperform and lowers the price target from $275 to $240.
